name: General PM Mock Interview
title: A realistic PM mock interview — then honest feedback on exactly what to fix.
lede: A proper, timed mock in the round of your choice, run the way a real interviewer would. Then we stop the clock and I tell you what worked, what didn't, and the specific things to change before the real thing. No sugar-coating.
reassure: 100% money-back guarantee — if the mock isn't useful, tell me and I'll refund it in full.
forYou: Interviewing soon and want realistic practice under pressure
Getting to final rounds but not converting them
Unsure how you actually come across to an interviewer
Wanting honest, specific feedback rather than reassurance
Preparing for a specific round and want a dry run
notForYou: You haven't done any prep yet (start with a strategy session)
You want a written resume review, not live practice
You only want reassurance, not candid feedback
howItWorksTitle: Pay, book, and we run the mock

howItWorks.d: Checkout in your local currency and you'll be handed straight to booking.
Pick a slot and tell me your target role, level, and which round you want to practice.
We do a realistic, timed interview on Google Meet — I play the interviewer, you perform as if it's real.
We stop and I give you a candid scorecard and a prioritised list of exactly what to fix.

deliverables: A realistic, pressure-tested run at your target round
An honest scorecard on structure, communication, and substance
The two or three fixes that will move you most
A stronger approach for answering that round type
Follow-up notes you can review before the real interview

faq.a: Whichever you choose — product sense, execution, strategy, estimation, behavioural, or a mix. Tell me when you book. If you'd rather be surprised the way a real loop does it, I can pick.

faq.q: How honest is the feedback, really?
faq.a: Honest enough to be useful. The point is to hear the hard parts from me now, not the panel later. It's candid but specific and actionable, never vague.

faq.q: Should I book more than one?
faq.a: Many people book a general mock first, then round-specific sessions to drill their weakest area. We can plan that together in the debrief.

faq.q: What if I want to focus on one specific round?
faq.a: Then book the matching round-specific session — same mock format, but the whole time goes deep on that one round.

finalCta.title: Practice under real pressure — before it counts.
finalCta.sub: Book a mock and get the candid feedback that changes your next interview.
